findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Objects stored here, including the customer-master spreadsheet, are not explicitly protected with SSE/KMS at rest by this Terraform configuration.

The customer-master.xlsx object is uploaded without an object-level server-side encryption setting, and its destination bucket has no default encryption configured. This leaves sensitive customer data without explicit encryption-at-rest protection in the declared configuration.
The financials bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Financial data stored in the bucket is not explicitly encrypted at rest by this configuration.
The operations bucket enables versioning but does not configure server-side encryption. Current and versioned objects are not explicitly protected at rest.
The data-science bucket has logging and versioning enabled but no server-side encryption configuration. Data placed in the bucket is not explicitly encrypted at rest.
